channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
